points.description: States one valid advantage of separating declaration from definition, matching the model answer: clearer/easier-to-understand code, OR easier changing/debugging/overriding of functions, OR improved modularity, OR separation of abstraction (interface) from implementation.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the advantage is vague (e.g. 'better code') or has a minor error.

points.description: States a second, different valid advantage from the same set (clearer code, easy changing/debugging/overriding, modularity, abstraction separated from implementation).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the advantage is vague or has a minor error; no mark if it only repeats the first advantage in other words.

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each distinct advantage that matches one in the model answer; clear synonyms are accepted (e.g. 'reusable/independent parts' for modularity, 'interface vs implementation' for abstraction vs implementation). Give half a mark for a vague or slightly wrong statement. Repeated or unrelated points earn nothing; a wrong extra item does not cancel a correct one.
